methodologyMarkdown:
## Overview
This source scopes the UN Digital Library (Invenio) to General Assembly documents — every symbol beginning `A/`: resolutions (`A/RES/...`), Plenary and Main Committee documents (`A/71/...`, `A/C.1/...`, `A/C.5/...`) and Secretary-General reports submitted to the GA. It reuses the shared UNDL Invenio mechanism, constrained to the GA series.

## Search
Endpoint `https://digitallibrary.un.org/search`, query in `p`, `of=recjson`. Constrain to GA with the series subfield `191__b:"A/"` (default query) or an exact symbol `191__a:"A/71/630"`. Combine with `year:2020`, subjects (`650__a`) or body (`710__a:"UN. General Assembly"`) using Boolean `AND`.

## Filters
Symbol scope is the GA prefix (pre-set). Interface language `ln`; sort via `sf`/`so`. Collection selector `c=` also exists but the GA scope is best expressed through the 191 series field.

## Pagination
Offset-1: `jrec` = 1-based first-record index, `rg` = page size; page N = `jrec=(N-1)*rg+1`.

## Download
PDFs at `/record/{recid}/files/{filename}`, preferring the `-EN.pdf` variant (e.g. `A_71_630-EN.pdf`). 302 → `/nanna/...` → `application/pdf`.

## Metadata & Enrichment
Per-record MARC21 XML at `/record/{recid}/export/xm?` (WAF-safe): symbol 191, title 245, subjects 650, GA body 981/710, files 856, related docs 991.

## Limitations
Scope is GA symbols only — no Security Council (`S/`) or ECOSOC (`E/`) documents. The `/search` list endpoint is AWS-WAF-challenged for server-to-server calls (HTTP 202); the `export/xm` and `files` record paths are not, so enrichment and download are reliable while result-listing needs a challenge solver.
probeNotes: Live-probed 2026-07-03. /search (of=recjson|xm) -> HTTP 202 x-amzn-waf-action: challenge (WAF). Verified GA record 855111 via /record/855111/export/xm? -> 200 MARC21: 191__a='A/71/630', 191__b='A/', 245 title 'Budget performance ... report of the Secretary-General', 981__a='General Assembly' / 981__b='General Assembly Plenary', 856 file URLs A_71_630-{AR,EN,ES,FR,RU,ZH}.pdf. HEAD on the -EN.pdf pattern returns 302->200 application/pdf (verified on the S/RES sibling; same /record/{id}/files mechanism). 191__b='A/' is the confirmed GA series discriminator.
